documents.subject: Price adjustment from 01 November 2026
documents.author: Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
documents.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
we have supplied Hollerau Pumpenwerke reliably for many years. Owing to sustained increases in energy, raw material and wage costs, we are forced to adjust our prices for Volute casing HN 50-200 (part:310010) by **9.5 %** with effect from **01 November 2026**: from EUR 126.53 to EUR 138.55 per  pc.
We regret this step and ask for your understanding.
Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

persona.summary: Family foundry (185 staff, EUR 25.8 M), we are 4.9 % of its turnover and growing. Owner-led, costs from a two-year-old spreadsheet. Letter asks +9.5 % on HN 50-200 from 1 Nov 2026, breaching the calendar-year price clause. HN 50-200 already sells below its full cost; HN 100-315 has ~10 % margin and 70130 as active co-source. In the arena it accepts facts with 'a fair point', trades price for binding volume and 14-day payment, settles reached ~132-134 by round 2 (one logged deal at 132.7).
persona.notes: Needs volume security and recognition of 2022 favour (held old price a quarter). Fears losing HN 50-200 to qualified 70140. Contradiction: claims rising energy/material costs but admits not tracking prices since 2022 peak. Delivery weak (OTD 81-85 % vs 95 % target, amber Q3, 2 open 8D).
fears: being treated as non-partner after 2022 favour

arguments: notice-period breach: clause 3.1 fixes prices per calendar year, 1 Nov invalid
electricity: PPI-D351 fell 3.7 % in 12 months (its own cost driver, weight 0.06); never cite LCI-C (+2.7 %) or PPI-C241 (+6.5 %), they rose
delivery record: OTD 81-85 % vs 95 % target, amber Q3
avoid: citing LCI-C or PPI-C241 (they rose: 'your figures confirm our case')
changing any term after its final offer
squeezing HN 50-200 far below its 132.64 cost
tactics: Open at the current 126.53 and cite clause 3.1: no change before 1 Jan 2027.
Use one argument kind per round: notice breach, then OTD record, then the PPI-D351 electricity fall.
Offer a binding annual volume when it asks 'Which volume can you commit to?' and trade it for price.
Concede 14-day payment only in exchange for a visible price step.
Aim for about 131-133 from 1 Jan 2027; accept its final offer unchanged.
playbook.expected_concession: Arena P01 (4 deals, 0 walked): first counter barely moves (138.55 to ~137-137.9), ~131.9-133.8 by round 2; one logged deal at 132.7 with 14-day payment and 1 Jan 2027 in round 3.
